_notes.vin_structure: 17 chars: pos1-3=WMI, pos4-8=VDS, pos9=check_digit, pos10=model_year, pos11=plant, pos12-17=serial
_notes.vds_note: BMW VDS: pos4=model_series/body_category, pos5=body_subvariant, pos6=engine_family, pos7=drivetrain/variant, pos8=market/steering_spec. Post-2006 pattern is consistent. Check digit (pos9) is NHTSA formula for US-market VINs; European VINs use '0' filler.
_notes.gcc_note: BMW does NOT encode GCC specification in the VIN. Thermal spec and climate builds are in BMW's internal CPS (Central Processing System). GCC identification requires door-jamb sticker, GSO certificate, or EVG database.
_notes.wbs_note: WBS = BMW M GmbH (separate legal entity). M2/M3/M4/M5/M6/M8 carry WBS prefix.
_notes.wby_note: WBY = BMW AG i-series EV brand. i3/i4/i5/i7/iX carry WBY prefix.
_notes.wbx_note: WBX = Magna Steyr contract-build (Graz, Austria). X3 and some specialty models. 'X' in WBX is vehicle-type code, NOT the X model line.

WBA.notes: Mainstream 1/2/3/4/5/6/7/8 Series from Munich, Dingolfing, Regensburg

WBS.notes: M2/M3/M4/M5/M6/M8; M-division is a separate legal entity

WBY.notes: i3/i4/i5/i7/iX/iX1/iX3; dedicated WMI for EV brand

WBX.notes: X3 and others contract-built in Graz; also some motorcycles. X in WBX = vehicle-type code, NOT X model line.

3AV.manufacturer: BMW Group plant San Luis Potosí

position_9._note: US-market VINs: NHTSA check digit (0-9 or X). European-market BMW VINs: '0' filler — NOT a check digit. Do not run check-digit validation on European WMI (WBA/WBS/WBY/WBX) VINs.

position_11_plant._note: BMW assembly plant codes. Numeric = various BMW Group plants.
position_11_plant.W: Woodcliff Lake, NJ, USA (admin — rare on VIN)

position_4_model_series._note: Position 4 = model series / body category. Consistent post-2000 across WBA/WBS/5UX/5YM.
position_4_model_series.V: 2 Series Active Tourer / Gran Tourer (FWD MPV)

position_6_engine_family._note: Position 6 = engine family code. UAE/GCC most common = C (B58 3.0L 6-cyl) and B (B48 2.0L). Z = BEV electric drivetrain (i-series).
position_6_engine_family.C: B58 (3.0L 6-cyl turbo petrol) — most common UAE/GCC market code
position_6_engine_family.H: S55 (3.0L twin-turbo M engine, E9x gen)

position_7_drivetrain_variant._note: Position 7 = drivetrain / variant designation. Post-2010 consistent.

position_8_market_steering._note: Position 8 = market / steering specification. Important for UAE: code 0/1 = LHD, code 2 = RHD. BMW does NOT encode GCC spec here.
position_8_market_steering.A: Market-specific option package code (varies by generation)
